name: The Lumber Axe is handed over when either wood trade is taken
contract: Taking Woodcutting or Woodworking hands over the Lumber Axe (6954), which is what a gathering character works a tree with. The book sells each trade's Apprentice row as a trainer spell that carries a learn spell, so Trainer::TeachSpell casts it rather than learning it, and what the character keeps is the spell it teaches and the skill the cast raises - which is why the grant listens for the skill moving and for the taught spell, not for the Apprentice row itself. A later rank of the same trade raises the skill again and must not hand out a second axe.

steps.label: a character with no trade starts with no axe
taking Woodcutting hands the axe over
raising the same trade again does not hand out a second one
nor does the last rank of the ladder
the other character starts with no axe either
taking Woodworking hands the same axe over
